scores.evidence: Every paragraph uses です・ます, and the tone is warm with no pressure phrases (lint finds no banned phrases). Each wrong-option feedback names the misconception and then gives the right idea (pq1 b, pq2 c, pq3 d). The en text reads as natural English, not a literal translation.

lessons:lint --strict reports 0 warnings, so every sentence and paragraph is within budget. The lesson adds no new terms. Each step does one thing, and the practice is split into three short sections.
壁打ち is defined inline in p-interview and in the glossary. MoSCoW and 1枚企画書 are linked to the glossary on first use. practice-recap reviews the four groups before pq1 and the sorting step use them.

Every learner-facing string has both jp and en, and the two say the same thing. Both diagram versions have alt text, a caption and a description. The 「期待される結果」/"What a good answer looks like" label in practice-tip matches the label in PromptBlock.tsx.

niceToHave: glossary: The 壁打ち and 1枚企画書 entries end without a verb (体言止め), while the MoSCoW entry ends in です. Make all three end the same way. — 「自分の考えを言葉にしていくこと。」→「自分の考えを言葉にしていくことです。」、「やらないことを1枚に並べた文書。」→「やらないことを1枚に並べた文書です。」
practice-plan-check: The second sentence of pq5 c's feedback says what is wrong but not what to do next. — 「物差しになる目的が、まだぼんやりしています。」→「先に、物差しになる目的を1文に直します。」
summary-ask: The en text repeats 'with'. — "Go through my one-page plan with the checklist with me"→"Go through my one-page plan with me, using the checklist"

check-quiz: In pq2, options a and b use the 「Should：…／Won't：…」 form, but c and d are full sentences. Making all four the same form would help, for example — 「2つともMustに入れて、最初の版で作る」→「Must：つけ忘れた日の通知とランキングの両方」、「2つとも、企画書から消しておく」→「どちらも書かない：企画書から2つとも消す」
summary: The Japanese is clear and warm throughout, lint finds nothing, and the jp and en versions say the same thing. Terms and labels stay consistent across the text, glossary, diagram and options. Nothing blocks the gate; the only open items are optional polish: matching the glossary sentence endings and making pq2's options the same form.
